name: Endogenous Selectable Reachability and Ecological Opportunity Thresholds
question: Can a heritable endogenous organization and its changed ecology make a previously possible-but-unselectable function advantageous, persistent in independently reproduced descendants, and useful in unseen circumstances, without altering primitive physics or externally awarding novelty?
four_distinct_levels: actual accessibility/expression in ancestral genotype or environment
net selectable benefit after full material and reproduction cost
causal daughter/granddaughter functional inheritance and blind generalization

competing_hypotheses.description: Only external novelty-exclusion rewards and bottle-necks make traits appear persistent.
competing_hypotheses.falsifier: After withdrawal, trait remains causally viable and makes descendants without copy/sort aid

competing_hypotheses.description: Fixed molecular dynamics and weak side activities explain observations without evolved accessibility.
competing_hypotheses.falsifier: An inherited causal change reweights the reachable function and survives reversion/rescue controls

competing_hypotheses.description: Genotype sorting rather than new emergent organization accounts for positive outcome.
competing_hypotheses.falsifier: New interaction causally absent in ancestor, transmitted by daughter collective beyond genotype-alone effects

competing_hypotheses.description: Endogenous selectable reachability under ecological/organizational coadaptation.
competing_hypotheses.falsifier: Matched resource-cost and ancestral-context controls remove new fitness advantage, or no independent daughter reproduction

future_only_evidence_gates: founder ancestral variant and intermediate background phenotype-versus-fitness double measurement
experimenter novelty reward absent and forced bottle-neck/individual cloning removed
possible reaction verified under fixed primitive physics and cost-conserving interaction
partial or externally supplied helper resupply held out as shortcut positive control
actual ecological utility and net survival not a retrospective novelty score
blinded unexpected environmental resource reversal or new partner without test score leakage
independently reproduced daughter/granddaughter collectives and all extinctions reported
scientific_boundary: no AI model built, trained or deployed, and no organism created or scientific studies reproduced; no Ora/AgentTest change authorized
